purpose: Test whether high-replenishment near visitor histories can reach at least 90% outcross fertilization of total ovules at the same fixed resident plant state; do not interpret near=high replenishment as full pollen sufficiency.
source_plant_state: run_model3_assurance_intervention.founders(); N=48 fixed assurance alleles 0.5; no plant evolution
primary_sufficiency_definition: For a candidate near pollen multiplier, fraction of ovules fertilized by outcross pollen, pooled within each of 64 histories over the 48 fixed mothers, must be >=0.90 for at least 60 histories, and mean >=0.90. Select earliest prespecified multiplier satisfying both; if none, report FAILED_NOT_ATTAINABLE and do not promote near as well-pollinated.
reference_check: At multiplier 1.0 original near and far raw deficits match 2026-10-05 published source summary within 1e-10; fail on mismatch
interpretive_boundary: This is post-discovery feasibility, using already exposed historical visitor draws at one static 48-plant checkpoint. It is neither preregistered evolutionary confirmation nor a test of 1000-update evolved compression. Raising pollen_budget scales pollen supply, not visitor arrival itself, and may fail to achieve sufficiency when visitors are absent or cannot match flowers.
